Second Quarter 2026 Updates • June: Announced topline results from the Phase 3 EPCORE ® DLBCL-4 clinical trial evaluating epcoritamab in combination with lenalidomide demonstrated statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in progression-free survival (PFS) in patients with relapsed/refractory DLBCL: EPCORE DLBCL-4 met its primary endpoint, demonstrating improved PFS.
